capabilities: Publish markdown notes to a GitHub repository
Upload embedded images to an assets directory
Convert wikilinks to standard markdown paths
Organize published content into post-type subdirectories
Unpublish notes and delete images no longer used
disambiguation: Not a vault backup or sync tool; it publishes only notes whose pb-publish frontmatter field is set to true.
extras: The README warns that users who don't know what they are doing should use the Digital Garden plugin instead; beta installation is via BRAT.
intentEvidence: I'd recommend using the Obsidian Digital Garden plugin instead.
motivation: The author had already built a site with Astro and found adapting the existing Digital Garden plugin to that setup harder than writing his own plugin from scratch.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to push selected notes and images to a GitHub repository as plain markdown for use by a static site.

relations.evidence: I'd recommend using the Obsidian Digital Garden plugin instead.
The plugin uses the GitHub API through Octokit.

requires.name: GitHub account with repository write access and personal access token

summary: Publishes frontmatter-gated markdown notes and their embedded images to a GitHub repository, converting wikilinks and organizing files by post type.
